description: The same product on OTHER SHOPS' own pages (beyond Amazon and Walmart): a web search (Google web + shopping results) and up to 8 shop product pages read now, each offer confirmed as the same item by its barcode or by the page's name, brand, model, size and pack. USE WHEN the user asks where else a product is sold online, wants a price comparison with other shops (Target, Best Buy, eBay, brand stores ...), a wholesale or retail-arbitrage check, or other web prices for an Amazon ASIN, a Walmart item, a barcode or a brand + model. DON'T USE for Amazon's own sellers (offers), Amazon or Walmart search results (serp), the same product on other Amazon marketplaces or on Walmart (shopping with match=true), or price history (product). RETURNS outcome (found | no_match), offers[] (domain, url, title, brand, price, currency, availability, condition, match confirmed | possible, confidence, matched_by gtin | model, pack_ratio, in_market, observed_at), offer_count, confirmed_count, product (the identity searched for), search (queries, pages opened / read), searched_at, from_recent_search. HONESTY: 'possible' offers could not be confirmed from their page; a shop that blocks readers is not listed; no_match means none of the shops in the results was confirmed, not that nobody sells it. MARKET US shops in USD (markets=any adds shops abroad). LATENCY 20-90 SECONDS; if the search is still running the tool says so: call again with the same arguments. COST paid plans. 70 credits when at least one offer is confirmed with a price, 50 when the search ran and no shop matched; a failed search is free. The same product asked again within 24 hours is answered from that search at the same price.

asin.description: An Amazon US ASIN we hold.

brand.description: The product's brand (with model or title).

country.description: Where asin / item_id lives: us (Amazon US) or walmart.

gtin.description: A barcode: UPC-12, EAN-13, GTIN-14 or ISBN-13.

item_id.description: A Walmart item ID we hold.

markets.description: us: US shops in USD. any: also shops abroad (in_market false).

max_age_hours.description: Answer from a search of the same product finished within this many hours (same price). 0 = a fresh search.

price.description: The product's own price in USD (optional).

size.description: Pack and size, e.g. '28 oz' or '6 pack'.

title.description: The product's name, when there is no identifier.

name: web_offers
